readers.summary: Commit 1 (e17a12ff09, 25 insertions / 43 deletions, only h/tron/models/self_attention.hpp) replaces PR 4956's layout-split token loop (two [[maybe_unused]] lambdas returning int 0 under VNNI, a null-initialised lazy keys view, and four `if constexpr (k_vnni_on)` sites) with one layout-independent 64-bit `live` mask built in the loop and one post-loop `if (live != 0)` block that calls qk_group for VNNI K or a countr_zero-driven dotter loop for row-major K. Row-major arithmetic is unchanged (same dotter construction expression, same `s_pages[offset][i] = dot_q[offset](keys[i])`, same ascending token order); the only behavioural differences are that the dotter array and the keys view are now created only when at least one token was selected, and that selection and scoring are two passes instead of one. 31 of the 43 removed lines were written by PR 4956 (commits 28064e6f84, dbcb28387f) and 12 are main code (comments and the moved pack-expansion lines), so commit 1 is mostly, not purely, a rework of PR 4956's additions; the `#include <bit>` it adds is removed again by commit 2 because the countr_zero loop moves to kv_cache.hpp, which already includes <bit> at line 6.
open_questions: count() <= page_size is not asserted where offset_bound is set (BASE kv_cache.hpp:1935-1940 asserts only `pageno() * page_size + bound <= book.tok_ct`); the mask's shift `uint64_t{1} << i` relies on it. BASE's VNNI branch already relied on it; commit 1 extends the reliance to row-major K. Resolution: read the set_offset_bound callers (compute_forward_args) or add TRON_ASSERT_LE(bound, page_size).

Line counts differ: git numstat for e17a12ff09 says 25 insertions / 43 deletions; pr5047-facts-known.md says +26/-50 (GitHub figure). Resolution: compare with `gh pr view 5047 --json commits` or the GitHub commit page.

Whether the HEAD library translation units that include self_attention.hpp / kv_cache.hpp compile is not verified here (no builds allowed); the CI Build Tron failure is in the test TU t/heterogeneous_scheduler_compile.cpp:688. Resolution: the CI job log (run 39468077391, job 118789619687) or a local build in the HEAD worktree.

For the commit-2 analyst: HEAD kv_cache.hpp:1993 derives the dotter scalar as `std::remove_cv_t<typename Q::element>` while commit 1 / BASE used `typename btensor_t<operation_head_size>::element`; whether these name the same type for every Q instantiation (bf16, float, fp16) decides whether the row-major dotter type is unchanged at the head.

No binary isolates commit 1: the 3bda campaign compares PR-base vs PR-head (both commits), and the GitHub benchmark of 251529f (commit 1 onto PR 4956, AMD andoria-09) compares against main nightly data. A commit-1-only perf statement needs a build at e17a12ff09 against a5697f86d3 on the same cells.

readers.summary: Commit 2 (ade89a9d9c) deletes the nine public K accessors of page in kv_cache.hpp (eight k() overloads whose signatures come from main commits ea3122b914 / 06b47b2561 / 493412716c, whose `!k_vnni::layout_on` requires-clauses come from PR 4956 commit caa0f38f72, and k_packed, wholly from caa0f38f72) and replaces them with three layout-hiding members: score_k (row-major: dotter loop over the live mask; VNNI: k_vnni::qk_group), try_score_k_amx (row-major: qk_rowmajor_128x4 on kv_block::k_view(); VNNI: return false; only under TRON_AMX_DISPATCH) and set_k_row(const expr&) (row-major: in-place k_at(i).set(row); VNNI: convert into a 64-byte-aligned bf16 stack row, then the store_row scatter). kv_cache.hpp now includes three kernel headers (no include cycle; <bit> and <limits> were already direct includes at BASE), Note [K VNNI storage] items 2/3/6 are reworded to name the new members, kv_block::k_view/k_at survive for row-major but every route to a kv_block (book::kv_block, page::kv_block) is private, so no public raw K view exists for either layout, and the dotter scalar type is the same bf16 / fp16 / float as at BASE. One behavior difference: for VNNI slots with bf16 activations save_k now always copies the row through a 256-byte stack buffer before the scatter (BASE scattered straight from the activation view), a cost only a TRON_K_VNNI=ON binary pair (b47bv vs b47hv) can show.
open_questions: Is the extra 256-byte convert-copy in set_k_row(expr) for VNNI + bf16 (Q2-6) measurable? Only the TRON_K_VNNI=ON pair (b47bv vs b47hv in exec/pr5047-20261020/) exercises it; the OFF pair (b47b/b47h) takes the unchanged row-major `k_at(i_page).set(row)` path. The prefill (TTFT/parse) cells are where save_k cost shows.

Does the deb-smoke-tests job (the only green build on the PR head) compile with TRON_AMX_DISPATCH? If not, try_score_k_amx (HEAD 2008-2029) has not been compiled by CI on this head, because 'Build Tron' failed at t/heterogeneous_scheduler_compile.cpp:688 before the test binaries were built.

readers.summary: Commit 2 (ade89a9d9c) moves K scoring and K row transfer behind page (score_k, try_score_k_amx, set_k_row(expr), get_k_row). For a row-major slot the AMX QK call is unchanged (same kernel, same k_view(), same arguments), but two paths gain a copy: (a) in TRON_K_VNNI builds with bf16 activations, save_k now copies every K row through a 256-byte stack temporary before store_row (BASE passed the activation row directly), and (b) FPGA staging (gof::populate) now memcpy's every row-major K row into k_scratch (n_kv_heads x head_size x 2 B per token per layer: 2048 B llama-3.1-8b and qwen3-4b, 1024 B gpt-oss-120b) on both prefill and decode, where BASE handed shuffle_k_entry a pointer into the page. The compile-time VNNI gate on the AMX dispatch is replaced by try_score_k_amx's constant `return false`, so a VNNI build now instantiates apply_dense_amx_page and, in the abstract machine, evaluates is_dense_amx_page on every visit before declining; the optimizer is expected to delete that, but this is not verified.
open_questions: Does the optimizer remove is_dense_amx_page and the unreachable apply_dense_amx_page body in VNNI instantiations? Verify on the VNNI-ON binary (b47hv): objdump the worker code for calls to weights_times_v_128x4 / qk_rowmajor_128x4 reachable from the 128x4 VNNI instantiation, or compare instruction counts of b47bv vs b47hv in the apply_page_range region (no build was run here).

Confirm C13 (expr overload chosen for bf16 kout) with a compiler: a static_assert on decltype of the chosen overload, or -fsyntax-only on a TU that instantiates save_k_impl with TRON_K_VNNI; not done because builds were not allowed.
Measure the FPGA staging K copy (C19-C21) on the option-OFF arms: qwen3-4b fpga and gpt-oss-120b fpga cells, b47b vs b47h, prefill (TTFT) and decode TPS; llama-8b cpu cells cannot show it.
Count the hardware-attention layers per model to turn the per-layer bytes of C20 into per-token totals (gpt-oss sliding-window layers may be software-only).
Is a float (tensor) activation executor instantiated in any production or CI build? Only host_bf16 and host_fp16 were found defined (common.hpp:101-102).

readers.summary: Commit 2 replaces every test write/read of K element 0 through the removed page::k view with two helpers (test::set_k_tag writes a whole zero row with element 0 = tag via set_k_row; test::k_tag reads a whole row via get_k_row and returns element 0), which keeps every converted check identical (only element 0 is ever compared) while widening each write from 2 bytes to one full row. The concept probes were re-pointed from page::k to page::get_k_row, so every TRON_K_VNNI #ifdef / if-constexpr branch in t_llama_unit.cpp is gone and the same assertions hold under both option values, but two probes are now vacuous: page_k_packed_accepts_geometry (k_packed no longer exists) and page_k_accepts_raw_index (it names Page::head_size, which page does not define, so the requires-expression is false for the wrong reason and can never fire). One page::k call site was not converted (t/heterogeneous_scheduler_compile.cpp:687-689, one 256-element zero row of the 256-dim slot), which is the CI "Build Tron" failure; the one-line fix in Ben's style is test::set_k_tag<software_geometry.kv>(*page, software_operation.binding.kv_slot, 0, 0, bf16(0.0f)); no test names score_k / try_score_k_amx / set_k_row(expr) directly, they are reached only through apply_page_range (t_amx_dispatch_dtype with fakes, t_llama_unit "pending attention waits..." unsplit step 7 and split step 11) and save_k (t_llama_unit "save_k stores every token's K row once...", float executor).

readers.summary: No. By whitespace-insensitive blame only 123 of the 307 lines PR 5047 removes (40 %) are text PR 4956 wrote; 184 (60 %) are main text (the 8 page::k overloads, the dotter loop, the AMX QK call site, apply_dense_amx_page's signature, and 74 test lines that read K through page->k(...)[0]), and of the 240 added lines 78 sit in PR 4956-only regions, 95 in main-only regions, 41 in mixed regions and 26 in a new test helper file. Every hunk follows from one decision that PR 4956's if-constexpr forks motivated: remove page::k and k_packed, and let page::score_k / try_score_k_amx / set_k_row / get_k_row choose the K layout inside the cache. Beyond restructuring there are two behaviour changes that matter for the perf check: the default (TRON_K_VNNI OFF) binary now copies every K row into scratch on the FPGA staging path instead of returning a pointer into the page, and the OFF binary's software scoring keeps the same arithmetic but runs selection and scoring as two passes; the ON binary loses the bf16 zero-copy case in save_k.

readers.summary: Code reading of PR 5047 head ade89a9d9c vs base a5697f86d3 finds no change on the row-major (option OFF) hot paths: the dense-page AMX call and the dotter loop issue the same kernel calls, and every added test is a constant after always_inline expansion. Two real additions exist: (a) option OFF, FPGA attention: k_head_fn now memcpy's each K row into scratch (2 KiB per staged qwen3-4b token, 1 KiB for gpt-oss-120b, same size as the V unpack that already existed), and (b) option ON: save_k converts the bf16 activation row into a 256-byte temporary before the scatter (64 KiB extra L1 traffic per llama-8b token), and the AMX gate (null test + is_dense_amx_page, ~8 instructions, plus a 1 KiB stack zero-fill unless the compiler removes it) now runs per (query, page, KV head) on the VNNI build. All are estimated below the campaign band (< 0.5 % est.); the cell most likely to show anything is l8b-tp2-8u-p8192-cpu basev vs headv (prefill time and TPS).

readers.summary: At BASE (PR 4956 head a5697f86d3) the VNNI K layout is a typed kv_block::k plus page-level accessors, and the layout choice is made by if-constexpr gates in four production headers (kv_cache.hpp, model.hpp, self_attention.hpp, full.hpp), with page::k() (row-major only, 8 overloads) and page::k_packed (VNNI only) as the two layout-specific views.
